description: Each handler is run in tokio::task::spawn so a panicking handler produces a serverFail invocation rather than crashing the connection. The task::JoinError::is_cancelled() / is_panic() distinction gives distinct descriptions for diagnostics. The test panic_message_not_in_response verifies panic payloads do not leak into responses. A future contributor might simplify to a direct .await to avoid the spawn overhead; this decision should be preserved because panics in async tasks propagate to the JoinHandle and would then propagate to the connection task without the spawn.
title: Panic isolation in Dispatcher::dispatch via tokio::spawn
